findings.claim: The test now asserts stderr contains the missing path, but no longer proves the store was reported as missing (versus e.g. a permission or other open error that also echoes the path). Assertion is weaker than the old text check. Also, if the sqlite driver creates the file on open (read-write mode), the 'missing' premise could silently change; the test does not check the file stays absent.

evidence: Only the test file changed; the diff replaces the OS-error text assertion with a path-name assertion and moves the missing path from a missing directory to a missing file in an existing directory.
Exit-code assertion (exitStoreUnavailable) remains and still covers the failure classification; the vault-unchanged check remains.
